iterations.explanation: Five orthogonal axes separate authentication, persistence, lifecycle, messaging, and notifications; values consolidate codes, with messaging–notification co-occurrence; no feedback.

clusters.name: Authentication Session Control
clusters.description: Authentication safeguards that vary by credential validity windows and user-session termination policies, distinct from application state, persistence, and communication design.

values.label: 15-minute inactivity auto-logout
values.description: Automatically terminates authenticated sessions after 15 minutes without user activity.

values.label: 30-second verification-code TTL
values.description: Limits verification-code validity to a 30-second window, reducing exposure of authentication credentials.

clusters.name: Data Persistence Access Pattern
clusters.description: Persistence-access abstractions that vary in how bike and usage data are encapsulated, queried, and decoupled from storage technology.

values.label: Repository-based data access
values.description: Encapsulates bike-data persistence and usage-statistics queries behind repository interfaces.

clusters.name: Domain Lifecycle State Management
clusters.description: Models rental and bike lifecycle behavior through explicit states, transitions, and timed orchestration, rather than communication or storage mechanisms.

relations.rationale: Lifecycle state changes in CityBike provide the domain events that notification mechanisms expose to riders, dashboards, or monitoring components.

values.label: State-based rental lifecycle
values.description: Represents rental lifecycle states explicitly using the State pattern.

values.label: Scheduled lifecycle notifications
values.description: Uses scheduled background execution for timed rental notifications and reminders associated with lifecycle events.

clusters.name: Asynchronous Workflow Communication
clusters.description: Inter-service workflow coordination that varies between asynchronous events, messages, and decoupled lifecycle processing.

relations.rationale: Message-based lifecycle processing commonly supplies decoupled event delivery for reactive status and availability updates, although observers may also be in-process.

values.label: Event-driven bike lifecycle workflow
values.description: Triggers bike registration and removal through asynchronous, message-based lifecycle processing.

clusters.name: Reactive State Notification Propagation
clusters.description: State-change propagation mechanisms that vary in how live rental, availability, and monitoring updates reach subscribed application components.

relations.rationale: Reactive notifications are driven by domain lifecycle changes and expose their consequences to user-interface and operational consumers.

values.label: Observer-based rental notifications
values.description: Uses Observer-style subscriptions to notify interfaces and components when rental state changes.

values.label: Observer-based availability updates
values.description: Uses Observer-style updates to refresh bike availability when bike status changes, with shared components maintaining the list state.

values.label: Observer-based monitoring updates
values.description: Pushes real-time bike-status changes to dashboard and monitoring subscribers.

clusters.name: Rental Pricing Calculation Strategy

relations.rationale: Pricing decisions determine the charge that payment integration must process, linking pricing rules to payment execution.

clusters.name: Identity Verification and Biometric Privacy

relations.rationale: Biometric authentication and retention requirements constrain how authentication controls handle identity data and associated security exposure.

values.label: Ephemeral biometric authentication
values.description: Uses thumbprint authentication and deletes biometric data immediately after verification to limit privacy and regulatory exposure.

saturation_history.rationale: All relevant open codes are already subsumed by the existing taxonomy. The session-related codes map directly to Dimension 1 (Authentication Session Control), including inactivity auto-logout and verification-code TTL. The rental-state observer/update codes fit Dimension 5 (Reactive State Notification Propagation), while the mention of event handling or scheduling support is already covered by the same reactive propagation concern or by Dimension 3/4 where lifecycle notifications and asynchronous workflow are modeled. The bike registration/removal and message-based lifecycle codes align with Dimension 4 (Asynchronous Workflow Communication). Repository-based persistence and usage-statistics querying are covered by Dimension 2 (Data Persistence Access Pattern). State-pattern rental lifecycle management and scheduler-based timed notifications are explicitly covered by Dimension 3 (Domain Lifecycle State Management). No open code introduces a distinct architectural concern not already represented by an existing dimension, so the taxonomy is saturated for this minibatch.

All relevant open codes are already subsumed by existing dimensions in the taxonomy. Bike location management and proximity query support fit Dimension 6 (Bike Location Discovery Strategy). Adapter-based payment integration, common payment interface, payment facade, and internal delegation to payment subsystems fit Dimension 7 (Payment Integration Abstraction). Navigation state machine, QR unlock flow, and rental lifecycle tracking fit Dimensions 8 and 3 (Rider Interaction Flow Modeling and Domain Lifecycle State Management). Configurable usage history report generation and builder-based report assembly fit Dimension 9 (Report Construction Strategy). Rental pricing calculation strategy fits Dimension 10 (Rental Pricing Calculation Strategy). Biometric thumbprint authentication and ephemeral biometric data retention fit Dimension 11 (Identity Verification and Biometric Privacy). Verification token expiry is covered by Dimension 1 (Authentication Session Control). No open code introduces a new architectural concern that would require a new orthogonal dimension for this CityBike design space.
